19.name: Cobblestone
19.why: Worn street stones, a steady gray that steps back and lets the picture speak.

19.name: Rainy Courtyard
19.why: Wet paving after a shower, a calm middle tone that sits quietly under the painting.

19.name: Tbilisi Stone
19.why: The old stone of a Tbilisi courtyard wall, my own quiet street from the Georgian thread.

20.name: Sunlit Plaster
20.why: Pale plaster in morning sun, a clean wall that never competes with the picture.

20.name: Feather
20.why: Barely there and soft, the lightest page in the book, restraint you can hold.

20.name: Tbilisi Morning
20.why: First light on a Tbilisi courtyard wall, the quiet I hope every painter finds.
